title: Lớp 8 — Đề Kiểm Tra Giữa Học Kỳ I (50 Câu Chuẩn Global Success)

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different vowel sound.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: moon /u:/; các từ còn lại có âm /ʊ/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different vowel sound.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: foot /ʊ/; các từ còn lại có âm /u:/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different vowel sound.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: book /ʊ/; các từ còn lại có âm /ɔɪ/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose first vowel sound is different.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: about bắt đầu bằng /ə/; các từ còn lại bắt đầu bằng /ɪ/ hoặc nguyên âm âm tiết đầu /ɪ/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different main stress pattern.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: countryside nhấn âm 1; các từ còn lại nhấn âm 2.

questions.stem_text: In her leisure time, Hoa enjoys ______ bracelets for her friends.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: enjoy + V-ing.

questions.stem_text: I usually ______ the Internet to find DIY ideas.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: surf the Internet = lướt Internet.

questions.stem_text: My brother is keen on ______ models from recycled paper.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: keen on + V-ing.

questions.stem_text: My sister would like ______ a photography club.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: would like + to V.

questions.stem_text: They dislike ______ noisy games late at night.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: dislike + V-ing trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.stem_text: Many teenagers enjoy ______ with friends after school.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: enjoy + V-ing.

questions.stem_text: My grandfather often works in the ______ to grow rice.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: paddy field = ruộng lúa.

questions.stem_text: The air in this village is ______ than in the busy town.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: so sánh hơn của tính từ clean -> cleaner.

questions.stem_text: Mai runs ______ than her younger brother.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: trạng từ fast -> faster.

questions.stem_text: Lan completed the project ______ than I did.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: more carefully than = cẩn thận hơn.

questions.stem_text: This machine works ______ than the old one.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: trạng từ well -> better.

questions.stem_text: Farmers are working ______ this year than last year.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: work harder than = làm việc chăm chỉ hơn.

questions.stem_text: The bus arrived late, ______ we missed the first activity.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: so chỉ kết quả.

questions.stem_text: I wanted to join the drama club, ______ I was too busy.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: but nối hai ý trái ngược.

questions.stem_text: Would you like to play badminton, ______ would you rather go cycling?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: or biểu thị lựa chọn.

questions.stem_text: Minh joined the art club, ______ he made several new friends.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: and nối hai ý bổ sung (compound sentence).

questions.stem_text: Some teenagers feel ______ before important exams.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: feel stressed = cảm thấy căng thẳng.

questions.stem_text: The school ______ meets every Friday to discuss students' ideas.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: student council = hội đồng học sinh.

questions.stem_text: Teenagers should ______ their time between study and leisure.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: balance time = cân bằng thời gian.

questions.stem_text: My cousin ______ a craft workshop last weekend.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: take part in = tham gia.

questions.stem_text: Lan: "Do you fancy playing badminton after class?" - Mai: "______"
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Đáp lại lời rủ rê bằng cách đồng ý tự nhiên.

questions.stem_text: Nam: "I feel stressed about my test." - Hoa: "______"
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Lời khuyên giúp giảm căng thẳng.

questions.stem_text: Student: "May I join the English club?" - Teacher: "______"
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Lời đáp cho yêu cầu gia nhập câu lạc bộ.

questions.stem_text: Mai: "Thanks for helping me with the project." - Minh: "______"
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: You are welcome = không có gì.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: "KEEP OFF THE GRASS". What does it mean?
options: You must not walk on the grass.
written_answers: You must not walk on the grass.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Không được giẫm lên cỏ.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: "NO MOBILE PHONES IN THE LIBRARY". What does it mean?
options: You must not use mobile phones here.
written_answers: You must not use mobile phones here.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Cấm sử dụng điện thoại trong thư viện.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: "CYCLE PATH ONLY". Who should use this path?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Lối dành cho xe đạp.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: "TEEN CLUB: The meeting starts at 4:30 p.m. today instead of 4:00 p.m." What has changed?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Giờ bắt đầu muộn hơn 30 phút.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: "ART CLUB: Bring a pencil and a notebook. Paint is provided." What must students bring?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Cần mang bút chì và sổ ghi chép; sơn đã có sẵn.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: "COUNTRYSIDE TRIP: Meet at the school gate at 7:15 a.m. The bus leaves at 7:30." When must students meet?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: Giờ tập trung 7:15 a.m.

questions.stem_text: How long does the writer usually stay in the village each summer?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Đoạn văn: spend two weeks.

questions.stem_text: Why does the grandfather leave home at six o'clock?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Vì người mua đến chợ sớm.

questions.stem_text: What does the word "yet" show in the passage?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: yet = nhưng, thể hiện tương phản.

questions.stem_text: Why do some villagers use smartphones?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: They use smartphones to sell farm products online.

questions.stem_text: What does the writer value most about village life?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: sense of community; mọi người giúp nhau.

questions.stem_text: What was the main goal of Screen-Smart Week?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Mục tiêu: balance online and offline activities.

questions.stem_text: What did Mai choose to do after school?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: Mai chose drawing.

questions.stem_text: What was difficult for Mai at first?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: At first, Mai missed her online messages.

questions.stem_text: What did most students report after the challenge?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Survey: helped them manage their time better.

questions.stem_text: Which title best matches the passage?
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: Ý chính: sử dụng công nghệ hợp lý.

questions.stem_text: Choose the sentence that has the SAME meaning: "Linh likes making models more than playing online games."
options: Linh prefers playing online games to making models.
Linh dislikes making models and playing games.
Linh plays online games more often than making models.
Linh prefers making models to playing online games.
written_answers: Linh prefers making models to playing online games.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án D: prefer V-ing to V-ing = thích ... hơn ....

questions.stem_text: Choose the BEST combination: "He practises every day. He still feels nervous before performances."
options: He practises every day, but he still feels nervous.
He practises every day, so he feels nervous.
He practises every day, and he never feels nervous.
He practises every day, or he still feels nervous.
written_answers: He practises every day, but he still feels nervous.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án A: but nối sự đối lập giữa luyện tập thường xuyên và vẫn lo lắng.

questions.stem_text: Lan makes more mistakes because she writes too quickly. Choose the correct conclusion.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Viết quá nhanh dẫn đến lỗi, nên cần viết cẩn thận hơn.

questions.stem_text: Choose the sentence with the correct comparative adverb.
options: My brother cycles more safe than I do.
My brother cycles more safely than I do.
My brother cycles safest than I do.
My brother cycles safely more than I do.
written_answers: My brother cycles more safely than I do.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án B: more safely than là so sánh hơn trạng từ dài.

questions.stem_text: A student wants to spend less time online and more time outdoors. Which plan is BEST?
options: Putting the phone away during a daily walk
written_answers: Putting the phone away during a daily walk
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp án C: Lựa chọn thể hiện hành động giảm thời gian trực tuyến và tăng vận động ngoài trời.
